title: What Is Catharsis? — The Importance of Cathartic Art
skills: define catharsis in literary and artistic contexts
analyze how art can produce emotional release or reflection
connect catharsis to tragedy and audience response
evaluate how emotional experience contributes to meaning and interpretation
alignment_note: Explores catharsis as an emotional response to art and literature and examines why cathartic experiences can be meaningful to audiences. Supports literary theory, tragedy analysis, audience-response study, and interpretation of how emotional impact contributes to meaning across high school English courses.
